title: Session-Zero Contract Review Freshness
dataSources: Character sheets (`rpg:character`), VTT sessions (`rpg:session`), initiative rounds (`rpg:initiative`), encounters (`rpg:combat`), campaign ops (`rpg:ops`).
app: Tabletop campaign telemetry — D&D Beyond character exports, Roll20 session logs, initiative trackers, and campaign asset checklists — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=rpg:ops campaign=* contract_review_current=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(contract_review_current="yes",1,0))) as matched by campaign
| eval a_current_social_contract_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_current_social_contract_pct
description: Measures the percentage of session-zero agreements that end with a current social contract by campaign.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which campaign are helping or hurting session-zero agreements.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a current social contract` on `rpg:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `campaign`.
visualization: Table of campaign with percentage of session-zero agreements ending with a current social contract.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often a current social contract happens for each campaign so you can see where session-zero agreements go smoothly or get stuck.
